titles.display: Al-Sayyid Bedouin Sign Language

description: Sign language local to Israel's al-Sayyid Bedouin village
extract: Al-Sayyid Bedouin Sign Language (ABSL) is a village sign language used by about 150 deaf and many hearing members of the al-Sayyid Bedouin tribe in the Naqab desert in southern Israel.
